issue_context.title: Follow-up on CR items from #23385 (strip insignificant whitespace)
issue_context.body: There are a couple of outstanding CR items in #23385 that we should do for preview 8. They just didn't make it in time for preview 7.

review_comments: Isn't `@preservewhitespace false` the default now? Wondering if purely the existence of this directive attribute is sufficient.

If you're asking whether we should allow `@preservewhitespace` on its own with no true/false value, then we discussed that when preservewhitespace was first implemented. At the time we agreed that since it's intended as a rare edge case, and people should nearly always leave the default, then it's not really advantageous to have a shorthand, plus we could always add one in a back-compatible way in the future.

Since we're in the last 1-2 days before ask mode, I'd recommend we stick with this. I don't think it's valuable enough to rush in a new syntax right now.
Or if I'm misreading your suggestion could you please ping me ASAP to clarify? Thanks!
